evidence_summary: Full reproducibility verification of hierarchical Leiden fractal map. All 18 evidence refs present. All 7 flat branch purity recomputations from saved labels match reported values to 10+ decimal places. Hierarchical Leiden (coarse_0.5_fine_3.0) achieves purity=0.9634 (vs flat 0.8749, +10.1%), nesting=1.0 (perfect by construction), 127 sub-clusters summing to 1000 decisions. Flat Leiden nesting imperfect (0.60) — known negative result that hierarchical Leiden resolves. State file correctly shows evidence_tier=REPRODUCED, cycle_status=COMPLETED, continue_recommended=false, next_recommendation=PRODUCTIZE. Orchestration failure diagnosed: prior run 33027907385 wrote continue_recommended=true and next_recommendation=CONTINUE despite PASS verdict; corrected in run 33028489959. This is the 4th occurrence of the same state-contradiction bug (prior: 33020090957, 33020622379, 33021595718).

orchestration_failure_diagnosis.root_cause: State written before final verdict inspection. PASS verdict means lane question answered → PRODUCTIZE, not CONTINUE.
orchestration_failure_diagnosis.recommendation: Add post-verdict state consistency check: if verdict=PASS, continue_recommended must be false and next_recommendation must not be CONTINUE
